from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetReport(BaseModel):
    """A specific asset metric extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the filing belongs to")
    filing_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this data")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the asset line item found (e.g. 'Total Current Assets', 'Total Assets')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for this metric")
    scale: str | None = Field(description="The magnitude of the reported amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_reports: list[CompanyAssetReport]
